_comment: What Odoo 19 needs on a machine. `odoo-ai setup` clones the required sources, creates the venv and installs the packages when they are missing; `odoo-ai setup --check` only says what is missing and the command for it.

repos.note: needs an Odoo partner account with access to odoo/enterprise

postgresql: 16 or newer (18 used here); db_template = template1 on Windows with PostgreSQL 18
